text: In Texas in the summer of 1973, five young people take a van trip to check on a grandfather's grave after reports of robbed bodies. They pick up a hitchhiker who slashes his own hand, find the gas station empty of fuel, and [wander toward a farmhouse surrounded by old cars|trigger|travelling somewhere remote]. Inside, a [man in a mask of skin waits with a hammer and a chainsaw|threat|people who kill], among [furniture made of human and animal bones|images|corpses and body parts], and Sally runs into a night with no help in sight.
